dedupe_keys.name: d ecoimpact spatial environmental impact kernel

description: D-EcoImpact is a Python kernel from Deltares for applying knowledge rules to spatial model outputs or measurements. It transforms physical fields into mapped environmental-impact assessments for the configured area and scenario. A user supplies model results or observations, a YAML configuration and suitable impact rules; outputs are calculated impact indicators for those inputs. Geographic coverage, grid resolution and period follow the upstream model or dataset, not a fixed D-EcoImpact map. The source is free under AGPL-3.0, with Poetry setup instructions, example run command and local documentation. A limitation is that an impact result is only as defensible as the selected rules and upstream model validation; the README does not specify a universal rule library for every ecosystem or infrastructure intervention. The package serves water-project and environmental scenario screening where hydraulic or water-quality outputs are available. The catalogue's model-epa-wmost-watershed-management-optimization-support-tool is a separate watershed planning tool for comparison, not a documented dependency. No impact scenario was run and no dataset was downloaded.
